description: The 3D scanner for in-situ rock imaging required more refinement than available mission time allowed — it could not reliably scan all rock sizes and types.
response: Test files were generated; follow-up was deferred to the next year.
lesson: Test all field technology before departure in analogous rocky outdoor conditions. Allocate time for technology trials in the pre-sim work days — not the first time you try it on Devon.
